text:
maria-ae: Quick thread - Quantico wants a 3-week POC: invoice parsing + doc QA. Need scope, golden set, acceptance gates, sec checklist, and rough pricing by EOD.

anita-se: core flows: single/multi-page PDFs -> structured extraction; doc-level Q&A; reconciliation stub.

kevin-ml: golden set proposal: 100 redacted real invoices + 40 synthetic edge cases (noisy OCR, rotated pages, multilingual). scoring: token F1 per field, and human pass/fail for Q&A.

omar-infra: perf guidance: for 8-12 QPS at ~400 tokens aim Dedicated micro (2x GPUs) or hosted reserved throughput. eu-west capacity available.

maya-sec: must-haves: TLS, KMS-encrypted at rest, allowlist CIDRs, audit logs. If they require BYOK or annual pen test that goes to enterprise path.

sam-sales: acceptance gates suggestion: extraction per-field F1 >= 0.87 on golden, Q&A human pass-rate >= 82% on sampled queries, p95 latency <= 350ms, no PII leakage in sampled prompts.

anita-se: regression rules: nightly run vs baseline. Alert if F1 drops >3% absolute. Auto-rollback only if F1 drop >6% or latency regression >2x.

maria-ae: timeline they want: Week0 data intake + sec Qs, Week1 baseline + golden build, Week2 iterations + infra tune, Week3 regressions + human eval + wrap. Can we commit?

omar-infra: yes if we get 30 redacted samples by Tue. i'll reserve eu-west Dedicated and run cost sim.

maya-sec: maria, ask Quantico for CIDR allowlist, whether PHI present, required retention, and BYOK need.

kevin-ml: prompt template for golden set (JSON-only expected):
SYSTEM: You are an invoice parsing assistant. Extract invoice_id, date, total, vendor, line_items [{desc, qty, unit_price}]. Return JSON.
USER: <OCR_text_or_raw_text>
ASSISTANT: {"invoice_id":"","date":"","total":"","vendor":"","line_items":[]}

sam-sales: pricing note for customer: hosted trial estimate ~$4-7k for 3 weeks; Dedicated prorated commit ~$3-5k + infra. omar to confirm.

maria-ae: next steps: i) send scope + sec checklist to customer today, ii) omar to share cost sim and eu-west capacity by EOD, iii) anita/kevin finalize golden templates Mon, iv) maya validate sec answers when returned.

deploy-bot: staging env quantico-poc ready: https://staging.quantico.redwood.internal creds in 1Password

maria-ae: thanks all, kick-off call booked Mon 10am.
